accuracy_progression.description: Single-shot extraction based on search snippets. Confused marketing claims with API reality; misclassified CLI tools as REST; hallucinated APIs for UI-only apps.
Autonomous multi-source verification: verified endpoint URLs, probed documentation auth headers, tested OpenAPI specs, checked MCP registries.
Manual inspection of all edge cases (DealCloud enterprise gating, NotebookLM UI limitation, Ahrefs enterprise paywall, Otter MCP endpoint).

sample_cases.name: DealCloud
sample_cases.pass1_claim: Self-Serve REST API with standard developer portal.
sample_cases.verification_check: Queried api.docs.dealcloud.com and Intapp developer terms.
sample_cases.ground_truth: DealCloud is strictly gated behind enterprise Intapp sales contracts. No developer self-serve signup or public sandbox exists; credentials provisioned per corporate client tenant.
sample_cases.severity: High (Prevented incorrect assumption of zero-friction onboarding)
sample_cases.lesson: Developer documentation portals often look open via Swagger/Redoc, but live API access requires corporate tenancy.

sample_cases.name: NotebookLM
sample_cases.pass1_claim: Ready toolkit using Google Cloud Gemini API keys.
sample_cases.verification_check: Investigated NotebookLM web application (`notebooklm.google.com`) and Google Cloud docs.
sample_cases.ground_truth: NotebookLM itself has NO public developer API or MCP server. While it uses Google Gemini behind the scenes, the NotebookLM product (notebooks, sources, Audio Overviews) is UI-only. Conflating underlying model with the product was a hallucination.
sample_cases.lesson: Do not conflate underlying foundation model APIs with consumer/research AI end-products.

sample_cases.name: Otter AI
sample_cases.pass1_claim: High Friction / Blocked because REST API requires Enterprise Plan.
sample_cases.verification_check: Searched recent Model Context Protocol directories and Otter help docs.
sample_cases.ground_truth: While REST API requires Enterprise, Otter launched an official managed MCP Server (`mcp.otter.ai/mcp`) that allows AI tools to query meeting transcripts directly via Claude/agent protocols.
sample_cases.lesson: Modern apps often bypass legacy REST gating by releasing native MCP servers.

sample_cases.name: Threads (Meta)
sample_cases.pass1_claim: Blocked; no public API exists for Threads.
sample_cases.verification_check: Inspected Meta Developer documentation for Threads Graph API.
sample_cases.ground_truth: Threads launched its official public API in June 2024 with OAuth2 support, post creation, and reply management. App Review is needed for production, but sandbox testing is open.
sample_cases.lesson: APIs in fast-moving social/AI categories evolve rapidly; active web verification is required.

sample_cases.name: fanbasis
sample_cases.pass1_claim: Blocked; consumer creator marketplace with no developer surface.
sample_cases.verification_check: Searched npm packages and developer subdomains.
sample_cases.ground_truth: Fanbasis operates embedded checkout infrastructure (rebranded with Commas), providing an official npm SDK (`@fanbasis/checkout-sdk`) and developer documentation at `dev-docs.fanbasis.com` with API key auth.
sample_cases.lesson: Niche platforms often rebrand or host developer docs on separate subdomains.

sample_cases.name: Sherlock
sample_cases.pass1_claim: Cloud REST API with API token authentication.
sample_cases.ground_truth: Sherlock is a local Python command-line utility, not a SaaS REST API. Requires local subprocess execution or Docker container wrapping.
sample_cases.lesson: Open-source GitHub tools in application lists must be identified as CLI/local runtimes rather than cloud REST services.

sample_cases.name: Mermaid CLI
sample_cases.pass1_claim: REST API with Bearer token authentication.
sample_cases.ground_truth: Mermaid CLI is an open-source Node.js command-line utility (`mmdc`) using headless Chromium/Puppeteer. Zero auth, 100% local execution.
sample_cases.lesson: CLI utilities require headless browser runtime or Node execution, not HTTP Bearer tokens.

sample_cases.name: iPayX
sample_cases.pass1_claim: Obscure or legacy banking portal with no public docs.
sample_cases.verification_check: Searched ipayx.ai and Supabase function documentation.
sample_cases.ground_truth: iPayX is an AI-native FX verification layer with a production Model Context Protocol (MCP) server running on Supabase edge functions, supporting Bearer tokens and SSE.
sample_cases.severity: High (Turned obscure entry into an immediate native MCP win)
sample_cases.lesson: Checking MCP-specific endpoints frequently uncovers cutting-edge agent support.
